x8.description_en: Defeat the notorious monsters Barometz, Slippery Sykes, Gluttonous Gertrude, bomb baron, Unknown Soldier, great buffalo, and Old Six–arms.
x8.description_fr: Vaincre Barometz, Sykes le glissant, Gertrude la gloutonne, le bombo baron, le soldat inconnu, le six-pattes ancien et le grand buffle.

x9.description_en: Defeat the notorious monsters Queen Bolete, Alux, the Jackanapes, Sirocco, Phaia, Haughtpox Bloatbelly, and the Prince of Pestilence.
x9.description_fr: Vaincre l'alux, le bolet royal, Zigoto, Sirocco, Phaïa, Haughtpox le ventru et le prince de la pestilence.

x10.description_en: Defeat the notorious monsters Cactuar Jack, elder mosshorn, Daddy Longlegs, Kokoroon Quickfingers, nest commander, Bardi, and Pyrausta.
x10.description_fr: Vaincre le cornemousse âgé, Cactuar Jack, le faucheux, Kokoroon Doigtvifs, la commandante du nid, Bardi et Pyrausta.

x11.description_en: Defeat the notorious monsters Uraeus, Spitfire, and Downy Dunstan.
x11.description_fr: Vaincre Uraeus, le spriggan coléreux et Dunstan le duveteux.

x13.description_en: Defeat the notorious monsters Shearing Sheridan, giant remora, and the lone coeurl.
x13.description_fr: Vaincre Sheridan le découpeur, le rémora géant et le coeurl solitaire.

x14.description_en: Defeat the notorious beastmen Lozol Totoloq the Decapitator, Flamefist Ahlygg Roh, and 3rd Order Patriarch Zu Ga.
x14.description_fr: Vaincre Lozol Totoloq le décapitateur, Ahlygg Roh poing de feu et Zu Ga patriarche du 3e ordre.

x16.description_en: Defeat Ifrit in the Bowl of Embers (Hard).
x16.description_fr: Vaincre Ifrit dans la bataille “Destruction d'Ifrit”.

x17.description_en: Defeat Good King Moggle Mog XII in Thornmarch (Hard).
x17.description_fr: Vaincre le bon roi Moggle Mog XII dans la bataille “Destruction de Moggle Mog XII”.

x18.description_en: Defeat Garuda in the Howling Eye (Hard).
x18.description_fr: Vaincre Garuda dans la bataille “Destruction de Garuda”.
